body_md:
This page lists six pool and spa contractors with a Pool/Spa Contractor license checked as Current, Active in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup. Each record includes a license number, a licensure date, and an expiration date, with a listed address in Sarasota, Venice, or Bradenton.

## How we picked

License type, license number, status, licensure date, expiration, and scope as stated were checked in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup. That lookup is the source linked on each entry, and the facts here link to those sources.

## At a glance

- All six licenses are Current, Active. Certified Pool/Spa Contractor licenses expiring 08/31/2028: Sparkling Kleen Pools & Spas (CPC1457982, licensed 02/23/2010), Pool Creations (CPC1458354, 03/21/2013), Jackson Custom Pools & Outdoor Living, LLC (CPC1459124, 05/24/2018), Ritzcraft Pools and Pavers, Inc. (CPC1459267, 04/05/2019), and On-Time Pool Service, Inc. (CPC1459543, 12/17/2020). Pool Specialist Inc is a Registered Pool/Spa Contractor (RP0052618, licensed 01/02/1987, expiring 08/31/2027).
- Stated service areas: Sparkling Kleen Pools & Spas, Sarasota, FL area; On-Time Pool Service, Inc., Sarasota area; Jackson Custom Pools & Outdoor Living, LLC, Sarasota area, with headquarters in Bradenton; Ritzcraft Pools and Pavers, Inc., Sarasota, Manatee, and Charlotte counties; Pool Creations, Sarasota County, Manatee County, and Charlotte County, including Sarasota, Venice, Wellen Park, North Port, Nokomis, Osprey, Englewood, Siesta Key, Longboat Key, Bradenton, and Lakewood Ranch. A service area is not stated for Pool Specialist Inc.
- Years in business, where stated: On-Time Pool Service, Inc., since 2004; Pool Creations, established 2013; Jackson Custom Pools & Outdoor Living, LLC, since 2018. Those notes are separate from the licensure dates.

## Things to know before you go

Where a scope is stated, it says the contractor cannot make direct connections to water or sewer lines. Sparkling Kleen Pools & Spas and Pool Creations can build or repair any swimming pool or spa, public and private. Ritzcraft Pools and Pavers, Inc. can build residential swimming pools and repair residential and public swimming pools or spas, and cannot build public pools. On-Time Pool Service, Inc. and Pool Specialist Inc can repair or service any swimming pool or spa, public or private, including equipment, interior finishes, heaters, and piping. Scope is not stated for Jackson Custom Pools & Outdoor Living, LLC.

Sparkling Kleen Pools & Spas states hours of Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-4:00 PM; Sat-Sun closed, and also lists a showroom address at 8111 Uzita Dr, Sarasota, FL 34240. Stated phones: On-Time Pool Service, Inc., 941-224-0404; Ritzcraft Pools and Pavers, Inc., (941) 538-7671; Pool Creations, (941) 366-6000; Jackson Custom Pools & Outdoor Living, LLC, (941) 866-2215.

Services stated: On-Time Pool Service, Inc. — weekly pool service, equipment repair, renovations including PebbleTec, pool automation, and 1,150+ residential pools serviced each week; LP gas installer LI45366 is also stated. Ritzcraft Pools and Pavers, Inc. — custom gunite pools, pool renovation, spa installation, interior upgrades, and a free custom quote. Pool Creations — new pool construction, remodeling, resurfacing, repairs, weekly pool service, and a retail store with free in-store water testing; build target generally about 120 days from ground-breaking, and the schedule can change; Pentair warranty center; Pool & Hot Tub Alliance member; PebbleTec and StoneScapes samples at the design center. Jackson Custom Pools & Outdoor Living, LLC — custom swimming pools, spas, outdoor kitchens, and outdoor living spaces, and a free design consultation. Sparkling Kleen Pools & Spas is T.D.S.Y., INC. d/b/a Sparkling Kleen Pools & Spas. Pool Creations is a DBA of R.A.C.E. Pool & Spa Services, LLC.
